cohort: The study included 120 primigravida women in 28-31 weeks of gestation with normal pregnancy, randomly chosen from health centers in Zahedan city.
finding: Motivational interviewing significantly improved participants' attitude and reduced the rate of elective cesarean section compared to routine care.
mod_finding: There was a statistically significant difference between the two groups in terms of delivery type (P = 0.03), indicating motivational interviewing can decrease the rate of unnecessary cesarean sections.
